lines.port: // HOME's note under the map: the Pokemon this map's tables can give (land, water, rocks, fishing; the night species too), with
// what the Pokedex knows of each (bit 0 seen, bit 1 caught) and how they are met (bit 0 land, 1 water, 2 rocks, 3 fishing).
extern s8 GetSetPokedexFlag(u16 nationalNum, u8 caseId);   // caseId 0 is FLAG_GET_SEEN, 1 FLAG_GET_CAUGHT
static u8 CtrZone_Add(u16 *species, u8 *how, u8 n, u8 max, u16 add, u8 kind)
static u8 CtrZone_Table(const struct WildPokemonInfo *info, u8 area, u8 kind, u8 count, u16 *species, u8 *how, u8 n, u8 max)
u16 night = CtrNightWild_Species(map, area, i, day, TRUE, IsNationalPokedexEnabled());
n = CtrZone_Add(species, how, n, max, day, kind);
n = CtrZone_Add(species, how, n, max, night, kind);
int CtrBottomWild_Zone(u16 *species, u8 *flags, u8 *how, int max)
n = CtrZone_Table(gWildMonHeaders[headerId].landMonsInfo, CTR_WILD_LAND, 1, LAND_WILD_COUNT, species, how, n, max);
n = CtrZone_Table(gWildMonHeaders[headerId].waterMonsInfo, CTR_WILD_WATER, 2, WATER_WILD_COUNT, species, how, n, max);
n = CtrZone_Table(gWildMonHeaders[headerId].rockSmashMonsInfo, WILD_AREA_ROCKS, 4, ROCK_WILD_COUNT, species, how, n, max);
n = CtrZone_Table(gWildMonHeaders[headerId].fishingMonsInfo, WILD_AREA_FISHING, 8, FISH_WILD_COUNT, species, how, n, max);
